35.text: ReactiveQuerySDK (https://github.com/jehalladay/ReactiveQuerySDK/tree/main/docs/program) now owns QuerySpec/QueryView and the pure absence evaluator. ReactiveLensesSDK remains **source freshness authority** through NativeSourceRef, FreshnessWitness, WitnessVerdict and pull/push resolver contracts; no second freshness implementation in QuerySDK or new query engine here.

37.text: Define an optional host/source-supplied **CoverageWitness adapter**: collection identity, scope, generation, population manifest/expected range, sealed snapshot, issuer/evidence, policy scope and invalidation conditions. A freshness witness for current values does NOT prove that all candidate records were enumerated. A coverage seal for an old generation may be complete historically but stale for today's task. Source-only "no records observed" cannot certify absence.
